sources.provider: 한국학중앙연구원 / Academy of Korean Studies, Encyclopedia of Korean Culture
sources.quality_notes: Modern scholarly reference dates the historic Grass River Academy/草江書院 to 1611 establishment, 1868 dismantling. The UTokyo G23:194 NII catalog records ink 草江書院冊 only on original volume114 and volume124 OPENINGS, not on volume52. Identity of the copy inscriptions' institutional referent, hands, custody, dates and any original calendar D16 field remains UNVERIFIED. Modern institution history is not physical original, not printed impression date, not numeric field glyph evidence.
